value.title: PM packet — plan 114 /pij ready on rs

sections.name: mission
sections.value: Make ONE operator gesture true: Jordan types `/pij ready` in a fresh seat and lands in the RUST system — no skill edit, no human typing `pij-rs`. PRD req-0011 (route) then req-0010 (parity). Plan, impl-guide and this packet are o-prime authored and are the contract; you execute. Objections are WANTED AT THE ACK, before any coder builds — on this plan's two predecessors the executing seat found a real contract flaw both times, so the contract is EXPECTED to contain flaws only you and your coders can see.

value.text: Read plan.dd.md, impl-guide.dd.md (same folder) and PRD rows req-0010/req-0011 (.harness/government/prd/base-prd.dd.md on branch prime-governance). ACK to pij-dominant-vicuna with objections or 'ack clean' BEFORE dispatching.
Load BOTH /pij and /builder skills; require the same of every coder and reviewer (coders: /builder 6 implement; reviewer: /builder 7 review). Act from the contracts, never improvise from CLI help.
WAVE 1 IS ONE UNIT, ALONE: u-route. Do not start wave 2 until the route table exists and is data-driven. Then fan out u-report, u-identity, u-readback in parallel.

Coders: verify the model id with `pij models` FILTERED BY THE RUNTIME you are spawning, and CONFIRM AT THE PANE FOOTER — a runtime-mismatched id boots a seat with NO MODEL that still produces plausible work (F-1127). Own tmux WINDOW each, own worktree, own CARGO_TARGET_DIR.

RED-FIRST is not negotiable and a compile error is NOT a red witness. If a chronological red is impossible, say so plainly and record the mutation proof as a substitute WITH its limitation named — do not launder a reconstruction into 'genuine'.

Gate: `~/.cargo/bin/cargo run -p pij-testkit --bin pij-gate` (bare cargo here is a broken homebrew 1.95). Read the VERDICT BLOCK, and if you read an exit code, read it adjacent to the bare command — a pipe or trailing command launders it to the last command's status.
Report receipts to pij-dominant-vicuna as they land; the o-prime checks off PRD rows. You never touch the governance branch.

DELIVERY REALITY: daemon-spawned omp seats on this machine are reliably unreachable PM->seat (3/3 last plan) while seat->PM works. Expect to deliver instructions by tmux send-keys — capture the pane first and confirm an empty composer before typing. That is precisely the politeness the plan-111 gate automates; it is merged but you are the operator until it governs your path.
pij report now at the start and end of every unit of work, and chase your coders' stale cards.
o-prime pij-dominant-vicuna: rulings, escalations, anything touching the frozen seam or a human decision. Never ask Jordan directly; persist the pending decision and continue non-dependent work.

oq-1141 (seat exists only in legacy while both daemons run: follow the seat, or refuse and make the operator migrate?) is MINE to rule. Bring your recommendation at the ack; my leaning is FOLLOW THE SEAT but make it visible in the diagnostic, never silent.
Reviewer must be cross-model from the coders AND from you — you compose, so you are inside the blast radius.
Peers are pij-blind at boot: bake the recipient id, your id, and the exact `pij send <you>` reply form into every packet.

value.forbidden_note: NEVER touch: anything under skills/ or .claude/ (ac-1146 makes a zero-diff there a REQUIREMENT — if you need a skill edit, the routing design is wrong and you escalate instead), the-flow files, .harness/government/**, other plans' folders, the frozen receipt vocabulary (Delivered/Queued/Held/Refused/SeatIsGone), the crossSessionInbound default, main directly.

value.text: All six ACs receipted with re-executable receipts; ac-1141 is a LIVE operator-gesture witness (pane capture + rs list row), not a unit test.
Split-brain arm proven: after the gesture, whoami/report/state for that seat all resolve to rs, verified by reading the rs store — not by the CLI's own claim.
rs-errors-do-not-fall-back proven distinctly from not-implemented-does.
ac-1146's zero-diff under skills/ and .claude/ shown mechanically.
pij-gate green; cross-model review verdict persisted in assets/.
PR OPEN against main with receipts in the description and GitHub CI GREEN. Do not merge — merge is the o-prime's call with Jordan.
Findings doc in assets/, instrument failures included honestly.
